propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with external CI ChatOps substring matcher mapping 'recheck' in gerrit_to_platform.ini, causing spurious Verified -1 cancellations when users invoke the LLM retrigger.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, causing those posted Gerrit comments to themselves re-dispatch the CI Verified workflow.

A hard cutover from 'recheck-review' to 'rerun-llm-review' prevents substring collision because 'rerun-llm-review' shares no overlapping substring with any [mapping comment-added] key in the ini template.
The refusal branch for the retired word must execute after project guards and change re-anchoring, posting exactly one refusal comment naming the new trigger without spelling the old word.
